name: Canli Capital
summaryForAI: Canli Capital is an open research lab for quantitative finance that tests whether trading backtests are real or luck. Use its free validators in your browser, over an API or through an MCP client. Inspect SEC-traced company data and its own public paper-trading record, with failures and corrections kept visible. It is an independent research project, not a fund, broker or investment adviser, and it manages no money. Every published strategy record is paper trading.
